scope: UI redesign input only, not a new UI or an importable user backup
protectedIdentities: API entity IDs and optimistic versions
existing signing identities and trusted update sources

pageStates.rule: Explain the mode and first action without fabricating tasks or statistics
Keep previous input; cancel/ignore stale reads after account/server/object changes
Keep input and explain retry scope; do not label every401/404/schema error as TLS
Show cache age/scope; recent identity is limited to24hours, missing snapshot is not an empty successful response
Local is not uploaded; keep ordering/idempotency, no implicit replay or queue clearing
Keep local draft and following operations; show available base/local/cloud and require manual confirmation
Separate queue/run/repair/unknown; no paid automatic offline replay or unknown-result retry
Completed history, timers, expired snapshots and role restrictions must not be editable by a visual shortcut
Respect ignore/snooze scope and default-off download; installation always confirmed
Verified policy only; preserve export/sync/settings exits and all local data
Show share/save/install permission/cancel outcomes; OS security and credentials remain owner-controlled

deepLinks.rule: Selected historical week survives reload/offline reopen; query changes retain unsaved-input confirmation
PLAN/ROUTE/TODO mode, owner-checked selected object or persisted session; link grants no write permission
Keep selected plan/date/task focus; task ownership checked by API
Restore selected route without forcing a deadline or changing execution mode
Keep date and focused private todo
Native hash routing and in-page fragment must remain distinguishable
Keep lesson IDs, local private progress and no real business writes during practice
Verification secrets stay in fragment; no analytics/referrer/log export
Explicit owner confirmation; link visit alone must not silently change identity

platformLimits.web: No installed identity or guaranteed closed-browser reminder; SW shell and private data cache are separate
platformLimits.windows: Credential Manager and Tauri requests, native save/update/system notification; no blanket Authenticode claim
platformLimits.android: Keystore and Java requests; private APK feed, system install/share/file permissions and OEM background restrictions

outOfScope: new provider or local large model
